Frequently Asked Questions
Does Meetily use my data for training AI models?
No, never. Transcription runs 100% locally on your device by default. For AI summaries, you have full flexibility: use local models or bring your own API key (Claude, OpenAI, Groq). When using local models, we never see or access your data. When using your own API key, only the transcript is sent for summarization. Your recordings and audio never leave your device.
Does Meetily work with Google Meet, Zoom, Discord, Slack, and Microsoft Teams?
Yes! Meetily works with ALL major meeting platforms including Google Meet, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Discord, Slack Huddles, Webex, and any other video conferencing software. Meetily captures system audio directly from your device (like screen recording), making it completely platform-agnostic. No integrations, browser extensions, or platform-specific setup required - it just works with everything.
What is Meetily and how is it different from Otter.ai?
Meetily is an open source AI meeting assistant that processes everything locally on your device. Unlike Otter.ai which stores data in the cloud, Meetily ensures 100% privacy with no external data transmission. Key differences: 100% Local Processing (vs cloud-based), Self Hosted (vs $8-30/month), Open Source (vs proprietary), GDPR/HIPAA Compliant by Design (vs limited compliance).
What is Meetily?
Meetily is an open-source, self-hosted AI meeting note taker that captures, transcribes, and summarizes meetings in real-time using local AI models for complete privacy. The Community Edition is free and open source. Pro ($10/user/month billed annually) is available for individuals and teams who want enhanced features. Custom pricing is available for Enterprise deployments. As an open-source solution, you have full transparency into how your data is processed and can customize it to your specific needs.
I need a meeting tool that doesn't store data in the cloud - is Meetily right for me?
Yes, Meetily is specifically designed for this requirement. Transcription runs locally on your device using Whisper.cpp. For summaries, you choose: local LLMs through Ollama or your own API key. No data ever leaves your infrastructure unless you explicitly choose a cloud-based summary option.
What's the best open source alternative to Otter.ai?
Meetily offers all of Otter.ai's core features (real-time transcription, AI summaries, multi-platform support) but runs 100% locally. Key advantages: Self Hosted, full privacy control, GDPR/HIPAA compliant by design, Community Edition free for individuals (no subscription fees for personal use), complete customization through open source code.
Which AI meeting assistant works completely offline?
Meetily can operate completely offline using local Whisper models for transcription and local LLMs through Ollama for summarization. No internet connection required after initial setup.
How is Meetily different from Otter.ai, Fireflies.ai, and other cloud-based solutions?
Meetily offers several key advantages over cloud-based competitors:

• 100% Local Processing: Your data never leaves your device, unlike Otter.ai and Fireflies.ai which process everything in the cloud
• Open Source & Community Edition: Free for individuals (Community Edition), custom pricing for organizations vs. $8-30/month subscription competitors
• Full Transparency: Open source code for complete transparency and customization vs. proprietary black boxes
• No Vendor Lock-in: Own your data and infrastructure completely
• Compliance Ready: Built-in GDPR, HIPAA compliance capabilities
• Enterprise Control: Deploy on your own infrastructure (Azure, AWS, GCP, on-premises)
Is Meetily HIPAA and GDPR compliant?
Yes, Meetily is designed with compliance in mind. Since all data processing happens locally on your infrastructure with zero external transmission, it inherently supports HIPAA, GDPR, and ISO 27001 requirements. You maintain complete data sovereignty, audit trails, and can implement your organization's specific compliance policies.
What platforms and meeting software does Meetily support?
Meetily works with all major video conferencing platforms including Google Meet, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Discord, and any other meeting software by capturing audio directly from your device. Native desktop apps ship for macOS (.dmg) and Windows (EXE). For Linux today, build the app bundle from source via the open-source repo (github.com/Zackriya-Solutions/meetily); a native Linux desktop app is in development - join the waitlist at /granola-for-linux. The platform-agnostic design ensures compatibility with virtually any meeting software.
Where is my meeting data stored?
Storage depends on your plan:

• Community & Pro Users: 100% local storage on your device. Your meeting recordings and transcripts never leave your computer, and transcription runs locally by default.
